description: Hand verification of every reachable and unreachable verdict in the Phase 3 real-repo corpus (bench/real/results), plus a >=20% spot check of cant_tell reason codes per repo. judgement: correct | wrong | correct-but-not-exploitable. This is what was checked by reading the code; it is not an accuracy rate.

read: advisory text: "...customAlphabet and nanoid functions of its non-secure module (nanoid/non-secure)"
changesFromPrepublishFixes.why: The re-asked LLM answer ties customAlphabet and nanoid to nanoid/non-secure (written verbatim in the advisory); the app imports the main nanoid, so the wrong reachable is gone. It is cant_tell, not unreachable, by design: subpath data never proves unreachable.

changesFromPrepublishFixes.cause: LLM re-ask (the advisory text contains an axios/... path, so the v1 answer could not be reused)
read: recorded v1 answer (get, from a PoC line) and v2 answer (names_specific_api: false)
changesFromPrepublishFixes.why: Not caused by the subpath logic: asked again, the model said the advisory names no specific API (it describes prototype-pollution gadgets read during any request). cant_tell is truthful; the earlier reachable (axios.get reaches the shared request path, not exploitable as written) is lost. Safe direction.

cantTellSpotCheck.note: transitive no_symbol_data (minimatch, qs, path-to-regexp, semver, brace-expansion, send, braces) correct: not curated and not sent to the LLM because the project does not import them; joi llm_tier_cannot_prove_unreachable correct: LLM symbols (messages, link, validate...) not referenced in src.

axios/mongoose llm_no_specific_api match the recorded answers; express gateway_used is truthful (express() called, LLM symbol redirect is a response method); transitive no_symbol_data entries are truthful. After the pre-publish fixes, also checked the 2 new cant_tell (nanoid 28wg other_entry_point, axios pf86 llm_no_specific_api; see changes).
lodash unmapped_subpath + eval_present truthful (async requires lodash/_baseRest, an internal helper); transitive no_symbol_data entries truthful.
sequelize llm_no_valid_symbols truthful (LLM proposed findAll, a Model method, not a module export; the guard dropped it); transitive no_symbol_data entries truthful.
mongoose dynamic_import truthful (prediction/worker.js:10 import(path.join(...))); transitive no_symbol_data truthful.
all 38 sampled are transitive no_symbol_data (vite, undici, protobufjs, npm-bundled tar/minimatch...): truthful, none curated and none imported by the project.
json5 transitive_parent_uses_symbol truthful (tsconfig-paths lib/tsconfig-loader.js:85 calls JSON5.parse); next llm_no_specific_api match the recorded answers; transitive no_symbol_data truthful.

The first (live) scan exited 2: tree-sitter rejected a bare "&" in JSX text at src/App.jsx:6-7 ("React & Tailwind CSS"), valid JSX. Fixed in ANALYZER_VERSION 3.0.2 (tolerated only when the error is plain JSX text); the final offline replay completes with the same 168 cant_tell verdicts. 34 sampled transitive no_symbol_data truthful; additionally checked all 3 non-trivial ones: lodash template transitive_parent_uses_symbol truthful (html-webpack-plugin lib/loader.js:32 and workbox-build call template); lodash unset/omit module_escapes truthful by the rules (eslint-plugin-flowtype passes require("lodash") into Babel's _interopRequireDefault helper), a precision cost: compiled Babel output is common in node_modules.

babel-cli / babel-register nested lodash dynamic_require + eval_present truthful: their loaders include a nested babel-core with require(parser) (lib/transformation/file/index.js:500), require(generator) (:699) and new Function (lib/api/browser.js:115), and babel-cli requires "vm" (lib/_babel-node.js:29); transitive no_symbol_data truthful.
lodash gateway_used truthful (node_modules/grunt-legacy-util/index.js:26 require("lodash").runInContext() returns a full lodash); transitive no_symbol_data truthful.
all 16 sampled are no_symbol_data: 15 transitive and rollup (direct, but not imported by the project, so not sent to the LLM). Truthful.
3 vite (direct) llm_no_specific_api match the recorded answers (dev-server advisories that name no function); 12 transitive no_symbol_data truthful.

15 sampled (14 transitive no_symbol_data, rollup direct but not imported) truthful; additionally checked the 3 direct lodash alerts: template transitive_parent_uses_symbol truthful (node_modules/git-raw-commits/index.js:27 calls template); unset/omit were name_as_string (rollup.config.js:14,32 lists "lodash" in rollup's external array); after the pre-publish Fix 3 the external entries are exempt and the reason is declared_unused, which is truthful: lodash is declared in package.json but no scanned file imports it (grep of the repo outside node_modules). Verdicts unchanged (cant_tell).

all 77 sampled are cant_tell with truthful reasons: vite is "transitive" because it is declared by workspace members, not the root package.json (documented limitation), but the LLM still ran because project files import it; vite dev-server advisories llm_no_specific_api match the recorded answers; GHSA-c27g (LLM symbol launchEditor, not referenced) correctly stays cant_tell by the tier rule; the rest are transitive no_symbol_data.
all 3 sampled are transitive no_symbol_data: truthful.

entries.why: jwt.sign runs on signup/signin via generate(); the advisory concerns asymmetric key types, but the app signs with an HMAC string secret.
jwt.verify is referenced inside decode(), which nothing in the repo calls (dead code), and the key is a string, not a key-retrieval function.
jwt.verify is referenced inside decode(), which is never called; it would only matter with a falsy JWT_SECRET_KEY.

sign and verify both run on auth routes; the advisory concerns asymmetric key types and the app uses HMAC secrets from env.
verify runs on every protected route; the key is an env string, not a key-retrieval function mixing key types.
verify runs with no algorithms option; exploitable only if JWT_SECRET / JWT_REFRESH are unset (falsy secret), which is a deployment question.
main nanoid() is affected for fractional sizes in Node; it is called with the constant 6.
integer overflow needs a user-influenced size; it is called with the constant 6.
